title: Geographic Map View (Leaflet.js) — Live Browser Validation (Second Run)

No manual invalidateSize() call was issued. The prior black-render and Tailwind img max-width interference are no longer present.

acceptance_criteria.title: Nearby markers cluster at low zoom; expand/split on zoom-in

additional_findings.title: Leaflet.js and leaflet.markercluster.js loaded from external CDN without SRI
additional_findings.detail: Both scripts fetched from cdnjs.cloudflare.com at runtime. No integrity= attribute. Risks: (1) CDN unavailability silently breaks the map. (2) CDN compromise could inject malicious JS with no tamper-detection. (3) Every map page visit sends the user IP to Cloudflare, undermining self-hosted privacy posture.
additional_findings.recommendation: Bundle both libraries under the app's static files, or add integrity= SRI hashes if CDN is retained.

additional_findings.title: CSP connect-src blocks Leaflet/MarkerCluster source map fetches in browser console
additional_findings.detail: The HTTP CSP header sets connect-src 'self' ws: wss:, which correctly blocks .js.map files from CDN. Not functional, but adds noise to the error console on every map page load.
additional_findings.recommendation: Resolved automatically if FIND-001 is addressed (local hosting eliminates CDN sourcemap URLs).

additional_findings.title: Two-click spiderfy required to reach primary marker when co-located with another at max zoom
additional_findings.detail: At zoom 19, HT008 Geo Validation and HT008 Cluster 01 share close coordinates and appear as a sub-cluster badge '2'. Reaching the primary marker requires: click sub-cluster to spiderfy, then click spiderfied primary marker. After the spiderfy click, the spider collapses. This is inherent Leaflet.markercluster behavior but may be disorienting for first-time users with many co-located locations.
additional_findings.recommendation: Consider offsetting demo/seed coordinates or adjusting cluster radius. Not a code defect.
